items.title: Sitting up straight may improve your mood and decision-making
items.summary_raw: A simple change in posture may subtly affect how people feel and make decisions. The results suggest workplace ergonomics could influence more than physical comfort.

items.title: 80-million-year-old snake brain reveals a surprising evolutionary secret

items.title: Scientists catch a “jumping gene” mid-leap between species
items.summary_raw: Scientists have uncovered a surprising way that “jumping genes” may move between species and speed up evolution. While these mobile genetic elements were thought to travel mainly inside viruses or plasmids, researchers found circular intron RNA from a tiny predatory bacterium inside the dead cells of another microorganism. Because the RNA forms a stable ring that resists breakdown, it may provide jumping genes with a previously unknown route for spreading between species.

items.title: Strange quantum experiment shows “negative time” is more than an illusion
